Description

Two-story house in La Rioja Residencial, a gated community with controlled access in the Polígono Sur area of Cancún. Built in 2024, it is delivered unfurnished and ready to make your own: a full kitchen with island and range hood, generous living and dining areas, and bedrooms with wood closets. Panoramic windows, air conditioning and a private patio round out the home.
